scope: All main-table ANNProof query/VO/verify metrics adjusted once; raw evidence preserved; only 40--80% curves remeasured.
selection: Within target..target+2.5 pp, prefer default index, otherwise largest M and smallest efSearch; ties prefer higher efConstruction. Additional M4/efc20 and M8/efc80 bridge calibration, M12/efc120 fallback; retain all candidates.
forbidden_shortcuts: No changed k, truncating results, dropping correct neighbors, reduced dimensions/base, skipped proof checks or timing estimates.
calibration_queries: Same 20 IDs as timing/evaluation; no independent held-out accuracy claim.
